subject.title: Inconsistent message:sent / message_sent hook coverage across multiple outbound dispatch paths

question: Should remaining outbound lifecycle coverage be centralized behind one shared exactly-once observer/reporting seam, or split into per-surface fixes for Gateway/WebChat/TUI/native channel delivery?
rationale: Current source shows real remaining gaps, but the durable fix crosses Gateway delivery, channel plugins, public Plugin SDK shape, and security-sensitive observer semantics; automation should not choose that API/product boundary alone.

options.title: Centralize the lifecycle seam
options.body: Define one shared sent-delivery observer/reporting contract and land narrow implementations for each remaining surface against that contract.

options.title: Split into per-surface canonical issues
options.body: Keep this issue as tracking context while maintainers assign separate Gateway, TUI, native channel, and plugin-SDK fixes.

options.title: Continue ad hoc channel fixes
options.body: Accept lower API churn now, but expect recurring hook-ordering and exactly-once drift across channels.

recommendation.title: Centralize the lifecycle seam
recommendation.body: Define one shared sent-delivery observer/reporting contract and land narrow implementations for each remaining surface against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision spans Gateway/TUI lifecycle and outbound architecture, where recent path history makes steipete the best available routing owner.
